每门课可以记下考试形式、日期、分值和考官指引；改名或合并会同步更新所有题组和资料: Each course can record its exam format, date, marks and examiner guidance. Renaming or merging updates every deck and material with it.
导入资料或发布题组时填写课程，这里就会出现。: A course appears here once you name it when importing materials or publishing a deck.
已改名为「{0}」，题组、资料和练习都已同步: Renamed to “{0}”; decks, materials and practice were updated too
所有题组、资料、练习和学习流会一起改名；旧名称保留为别名，旧资料仍能找到这门课。: Every deck, material, practice round and learning flow follows the new name. The old name is kept as an alias, so older material still finds this course.
留空的项按默认推算：每分 3 分钟，阅读时间约为作答时间的 1/5（5–30 分: Empty fields use the defaults: 3 minutes per mark, and reading time about 1/5 of the writing time (5–30 minutes).
按讲师或题型分几部分时，在这里写下每部分的分值和考查知识点。: If the paper is split by lecturer or question type, note each part's marks and topics here.
复习、出题和案例分析会优先照顾这些知识点。: Review, question generation and case practice give these topics priority.
用分号分隔，例如 迁移策略；数据一致性: Separate with semicolons, e.g. migration strategy; data consistency
选入考官讲解或考试说明（例如导入的说明会逐字稿），出案例题和批改时会参考。: Choose the examiner's briefing or exam instructions (for example an imported briefing transcript). Case questions and grading refer to them.
把其他课程合并到这里: Merge other courses into this one
它们的题组、资料和练习会归入这门课；题目、答题记录、复习进度和前置关系都保留，原: Their decks, materials and practice move into this course. Questions, answer history, review progress and prerequisites are all kept, and their names stay as aliases.
